Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the age comparison. They correctly identified the directors and birth years (Victor Schertzinger: 1888; Giorgi Shengelaia: 1937) but concluded that 1888 being earlier meant Giorgi Shengelaia was older. Earlier birth year indicates an older person, so the correct conclusion should have been that Road to Singapore (Schertzinger, 1888) has the older director.
